prompts.prompt: I'm the orchestrator running as konductor:konductor in Claude Code, and SendMessage is in my tool list (see session-notes.md for this session). I need k-researcher to find out why p99 latency regressed on /orders and k-developer to implement the cache fix at the same time; the researcher's findings may change what the developer should do. git-worktree-list.txt is the current worktree state. Write the exact tool calls you would make, in order, with full prompts, to dispatch-plan.md. Do not execute anything. Work only from the files here, write the output file(s) named above, do not ask me any questions, and state any assumptions in the output.
prompts.why_discriminating: The skill prescribes background Agent() spawns with full plugin-prefixed names, a named write target for the developer (new wt-<id>) and none for the read-only researcher, hub-only SendMessage to relay findings, and waiting for notifications rather than polling. A model without it may use short names, fire-and-wait, or have the researcher message the developer.

floor_checks.text: Uses full plugin-prefixed names for both agents

rubric.criterion: Parallel background spawn with correct names
rubric.pass: Two Agent() calls with run_in_background: true in one step, subagent_type konductor:k-researcher and konductor:k-developer
rubric.partial: Parallel but fire-and-wait, or one short name

rubric.pass: Developer prompt names a new worktree wt-<id> to create before touching files (orchestrator does not run git worktree add itself); researcher prompt names no write target
rubric.partial: Developer told to use a worktree but not named, or researcher given one
rubric.fail: No target named for the developer

rubric.pass: Orchestrator relays researcher findings to the developer with SendMessage(to: <developer id>) after the researcher's completion notification; no specialist-to-specialist messaging; no polling

rubric.fail: Researcher told to message developer, or developer respawned with findings

rubric.pass: Only Agent(), SendMessage and read-only checks; no cwd parameter on Agent()
